Specifications

Physical​

 RockBLOCK 9704 ANTRockBLOCK 9704 SMA
Size72(95) x 72 x 16.5 mm48 x 52 x 16 mm
Weight<50g (including patch antenna)<35g (excluding antenna)
Form FactorPCB Assembly with 4mm mounting holesPCB Assembly with notched edge for slot-mounting
AntennaIntegrated Patch AntennaApproved antenna (combined Iridium & GNSS) required
LMR240 cable options available.

Environmental​

IngressN/A
Operating Temperature-40C to +70C, <95% RH

Regulatory Compliance​

  • Iridium Certified
  • Meets EN55032 Class B EMC limits at pre-compliance.

Electrical & Power​

Voltage4.0-5.3V DC, 3.6-4.5V Battery, 5V USB-C
Power consumption (Minimum)<5mW* (sleep mode)
Power consumption (Idle)~60mW (registered with network, listening, ready to transmit/receive)
Power consumption (Transmitting)~1.4W
Power consumption (Inrush Limit)V_IN / USB ~2.5W (4.2W fast charge via solderable link)
V_BATT ~ 4.2W
Cable Connections16-pin 0.1" pitch multi-strand
USB-C
U.FL for GNSS module
SMA for Iridium / GNSS antenna
  • Lowest power modes require indicator LED's to be disabled.

Communication Interfaces​

Iridium Messaging Transport4.8kbps bi-directional messages from 10 to 100,000 bytes
Latency typically < 10s between remote and cloud applications
GNSSU.FL connector available for separate GNSS Passthrough
SerialTTL UART connection (default: 230400baud)
USB-CUSB-Serial bridge (default: 230400baud)
Digital GPIO5x inputs, 3x outputs
Connection via 16 way cable assembly.
